meta.source: Weights from src/fcf_m2/scoring.py; subscores from the canonical milestone2_v3 site results. Generated by site/redesign/tools/build_scoring.py.
meta.rounding: Each part is its subscore times its weight, rounded to 0.1 so the parts add up to the published score.

parts.name: Demand
parts.text: Whether the site is likely to attract enough public charging: the people, jobs, traffic and destinations around it, how long and how often people visit, and how much charging is already nearby.

drivers.name: Traffic on the nearest main road
Shops and services within half a mile
Local share of electric vehicles
drivers.note: Full credit at a 10 percent share or more.

drivers.name: Charging already nearby
drivers.note: Level 2 ports within 1 mile plus fast-charging ports within 3 miles. Fewer earns more.

parts.name: Feasibility
parts.text: How hard and costly the electrical work looks: spare capacity, how far chargers would sit from the electrical service, the estimated installation cost and the length of trenching.

drivers.name: Spare electrical capacity
drivers.note: An unverified placeholder at all 12 sites.

drivers.name: Estimated installation cost
drivers.note: Trenching cost plus any service upgrade. Lower earns more.

parts.name: Safety
parts.text: Whether an accessible (ADA) layout and fire access are possible, whether chargers would sit in an enclosed garage, whether the emergency disconnect would be visible, and stormwater risk.

drivers.name: Not in an enclosed garage
drivers.note: An enclosed garage earns nothing here and also triggers high review.

parts.name: Equity
parts.text: How underserved the surrounding area is for charging, from a 0 to 1 equity gap index.
